description:
AgentServer has no `format_status/1`, so a crash report includes Agent state (forced crash logged the sentinel). `Jido.Signal.Bus.Server` has one. **Security-adjacent: consider P1 alongside B01.**

Owner: `jido.agent_server.handoff`
Root cause: absence in `lib/jido/agent_server.ex`; compare `lib/jido/signal/bus/server.ex:105`
Claims: operations.B6
Repro (probe file: id prefix): `40_d_operations`: `operations.B6`
Guides: `guides/operations/security.md`

Done when: A forced crash report and :sys.get_status omit Agent state values, with a sentinel test.

Source: guide-report triage, finding B14. Reproduction probes are gitignored and exist only in the main checkout under tmp/guide-reports/probes/. Full evidence: tmp/guide-reports/triage-findings.md and probes/results-*.md. Add a test and any contract change in this change, and remove or correct the listed guide text. The guides must be committed before a fix edits them.

comments.text: Fixed in 56aa272. Residual gap: OTP passes stacktraces through, so a FunctionClauseError in a private function can still print arguments including state. The security guide says so.

title: Add format_status to AgentServer to keep state out of crash reports
